study_identification_part.si_4_title: Analyzing heterogeneity in Alzheimer disease using multimodal normative modeling on imaging-based ATN biomarkers

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) was used as the discovery dataset. The Charles F. and Joanne Knight Alzheimer's Disease Research Center (ADRC) dataset was used as the replication dataset.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We constructed a discovery dataset consisting of individuals from ADNI and a replication dataset consisting of individuals from the Charles F. and Joanne Knight ADRC dataset...
